div.div: جَلَحٌ Baldness in the two sides of the head: (S, K:) or in the two sides of the fore part of the head: (Msb:) it is more than نَزَعٌ, and less than صَلَعٌ, (S, Msb,) which is less than جَلَهٌ: (Msb:) or baldness in the fore part of the head: or baldness that is a little more than what is termed نَزَعٌ. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
